SEARCH

Class Boat

java.lang.Object
Boat
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Boat extends Object implements Serializable
One boat of the club's fleet: its type, name, year of manufacture, make/model, length and purchase price, and the expenses made maintaining it. A boat applies the Commodore's policy: the club may not spend more on a boat than it cost to buy.
Author:
Maxime Manuel Afonso

  • Constructor Details

    • Boat

      public Boat(BoatType type, String name, short yearOfManufacture, String makeAndModel, byte lengthInFeet, double purchasePrice)
      Creates a boat on which nothing has been spent yet.
      Parameters:
      type - the type of the boat, sailing or power
      name - the name of the boat
      yearOfManufacture - the year in which the boat was built
      makeAndModel - the make/model of the boat
      lengthInFeet - the length of the boat in feet, up to 100
      purchasePrice - the price paid for the boat in dollars, less than a million

      public double getRemainingBudget()
      Gets the money that may still be spent on the boat under the Commodore's policy: the purchase price less the expenses already made.
      Returns:
      the amount left to spend in dollars, to the cent

    • spend

      public boolean spend(double amount)
      Requests permission to spend money on the boat. The Commodore's policy is applied: the expense is authorized, and added to the expenses of the boat, only if the total spent on the boat does not become more than its purchase price.
      Parameters:
      amount - the amount to spend in dollars
      Returns:
      true if the expense is authorized and has been recorded, false if it is not permitted (the expenses of the boat are then unchanged)

    • formatReportLine

      public static String formatReportLine(String description, double amountPaid, double amountSpent)
      Formats one line of a fleet report: a description followed by an amount paid and an amount spent. Every line of a report is made here, so that the amounts are in the same columns for a boat and for the totals of a fleet.
      Parameters:
      description - what the amounts are about: a boat, or the label of a total
      amountPaid - the amount paid in dollars
      amountSpent - the amount spent in dollars
      Returns:
      the formatted line
